summary: Twin Vee PowerCats Co. entered into a definitive merger agreement with USFM Corporation, where USFM's merger sub will merge into Twin Vee, leaving Twin Vee as the surviving wholly-owned subsidiary. Shareholders will receive a pro rata portion of Acquiror Shares representing 10% of USFM's fully diluted post-merger common stock. The board can consider superior proposals under a fiduciary-out. The transaction is structured as a stock-for-stock merger, not a cash tender. Watch for stockholder vote timing and potential competing bids, as the stock consideration is fixed at a 10% ownership slice.
